# weapon-mods

Patch rows on this catalog use `"catalog": "weapon-mods"` and a `key` from the records below. The catalog is closed: a mod changes values with patch rows (see [Patch operations](patch-ops.md)) and cannot add records.

## Records

`hv`, `pd`, `ap`, `co`, `nr`, `sp`, `af`, `env`, `mirv`, `eccm`, `arm`, `fst`, `emg`, `ovr`

## Copy this row

A row that changes nothing: `value` and `expect` both hold the base value. Change `value` to the number you want.

```json
{
  "op": "set",
  "catalog": "weapon-mods",
  "key": "hv",
  "path": "damagePct",
  "value": 150,
  "expect": {"damagePct":150}
}
```

|---|---|

| `requiresApplication` | integer >= 1 or null |
